_note: The assistant's eval set (#388): a request on a starting song, graded by code. Every case with a song expected also checks that it parses and renders clean. Run: assist eval --provider anthropic --model claude-opus-5-5. Each run costs real money.

cases.request: Add a snare on the backbeat to the beat clip.
Make it 128 BPM.
Give it more swing, a real shuffle.
Add a ride cymbal in the last scene.
Add a warm pad playing Fm7 to Dbmaj7, one chord a bar, in every scene but the first.
Put a one-bar drum fill with ghost notes and flams before each scene change.
Give the acid line more slides and accents.
Make the resonance build up over the whole song.
Add a 4-bar breakdown without drums in the middle of the arrangement.
Add 808 congas in polymeter beside the 909.
Add an arpeggio over the chorus, on a Juno-106.
Move the whole song to A minor.
Add a euclidean cowbell to the verse beat.
Make the bass bounce reverse every fourth bar.
Send the snare into a long echo in the dub scene.
Add a melodica-like lead playing a short phrase in the walk scene.
Make the sub bass a modular sine with a short envelope instead of the SH-101.
Re-harmonise the bass around F minor, Db major, Ab major and Eb major.
Make the build scene rise: a snare roll and an opening filter.
Add an 8-bar outro where the parts drop out one by one.
Add a second kalimba line in sevens against the five.
The marimba is too loud; bring it down and pan it further left.
Make the lead wander only on the scale's chord tones, still live.
Let the pluck's pan move twice as fast.
Make the hoover darker and slower to open.
Double the Jupiter strings an octave higher on the Polymoog in the drop.
Write a 16-bar house groove: a 909 kick, clap, hats and an SH-101 bass in A minor, with an intro.
Write a slow ambient piece: a wide pad, a sparse bell melody and no drums.
